Version, privacy and the open-source components this app is built on.

When you use an AI image feature, the selected photo is uploaded to the API endpoint configured in Settings and processed on that service. In Grok subscription mode, photos and instructions go to xAI\'s fixed address api.x.ai, not to the address in Settings. No photo is uploaded when AI processing is not used.

While the camera FTP service runs, it opens a listening port on the local network. Anyone on the same network who knows the account can upload photos to this device. Stop the service when it is not needed.

The API key and the FTP password are held in the encrypted storage of this device and are never transmitted anywhere except to the API endpoint you configured. Grok subscription sign-in authorizes the app with xAI in your browser; the resulting tokens are stored encrypted on this device only, are left out of backups and device transfers, and are sent only to xAI\'s sign-in and image services.
Photos, edits and the activity log remain on this device.
